product_name: Elodie Details Organiser - Blue Garden
description: Keep all your baby essentials close at hand with the Elodie Details Organiser. Designed to attach easily to your stroller’s handlebars, this stylish organiser makes diaper changes and outings effortless, while keeping everything neat and tidy. Featuring a zippered lid, the organiser hides away your items for a polished look, yet opens wide to give you full access to four internal compartments and two discreet external pockets - perfect for phone, keys, and wallet. A clever loop inside lets you hang it on a wall for easy access at home. Made from durable cotton/polyester fabric, it’s designed to last through busy baby days and beyond, transforming into a handy travel toiletry bag once nappy duty is done.

product_name: Love to Dream Baby Sleep Bag (2.5 Tog) - Storm Blue
description: The Love to Dream™ Sleep Bag (2.5 TOG) is a safer, cosier alternative to loose blankets, helping your little one drift off in warmth and comfort. Perfect for cooler nights, this wearable blanket is thoughtfully designed with soft organic cotton, a built-in quilted layer for extra warmth, and roomy sizing for natural movement. With twin zippers for fuss-free changes and sleeves to keep little arms snug, it’s a sleep essential that keeps baby cosy and parents reassured.

product_name: Mountain Buggy Duet Travel System - Caviar - Caviar
description: From the very first journey home to family adventures off the beaten track, the Mountain Buggy Duet Travel System is designed to keep life moving with ease. Pairing the award-winning Duet V4 Pushchair with the lightweight Mountain Buggy Nest R129 i-Size Car Seat and rotating ISOFIX base, this complete travel system offers everything you need for safe, comfortable travel from birth. The Duet V4 is one of the world's slimmest all-terrain side-by-side pushchairs, making it ideal for twins or siblings without compromising on manoeuvrability. Air-filled tyres, all-wheel suspension and premium Heritage Collection finishes ensure every stroll is smooth, while lie-flat seating, breathable fabrics and UPF50+ canopies keep little ones comfortable in every season. Included in the bundle, the Nest R129 i-Size Car Seat provides advanced safety from 40-87cm (approximately birth to 20+ months). Its included 180° rotating ISOFIX base makes getting your baby in and out of the car easier than ever, while the lightweight 3.9kg design clicks effortlessly onto the Duet chassis to create a seamless travel system. With intuitive installation, extended rear-facing travel and premium comfort features, every transition is simple, secure and stress-free. Whether you're exploring woodland trails, navigating busy streets or managing life with twins or siblings, the Mountain Buggy Duet Travel System delivers exceptional flexibility, premium comfort and trusted safety for every family adventure.

product_name: Mountain Buggy Terrain Travel System - Onyx - Onyx
description: From everyday strolls to outdoor adventures, the Mountain Buggy Terrain Travel System is designed for active families who want uncompromising performance from birth. Combining the Terrain V4 Pushchair with the lightweight Mountain Buggy Nest R129 i-Size Car Seat and rotating ISOFIX base, this complete travel system delivers exceptional comfort, safety and flexibility wherever life takes you. As the powerhouse of Mountain Buggy's 3-wheel range, the Terrain V4 adapts effortlessly to every environment. Interchangeable rear wheels allow you to switch between 12" urban tyres for city life and 16" active tyres for off-road adventures in seconds. Advanced suspension, adjustable tracking and a hand-operated active brake provide outstanding control and stability, while the supportive sling seat offers lie-flat comfort for newborns and an upright position as your little one grows. Included in the bundle, the Nest R129 i-Size Car Seat offers trusted protection from 40-87cm (approximately birth to 20+ months). Its included 180° rotating ISOFIX base makes lifting your baby in and out of the car wonderfully easy, while intuitive visual indicators ensure secure installation every time. Weighing just 3.9kg, the car seat attaches effortlessly to the Terrain chassis, creating a seamless travel system for smooth transitions between car and pushchair. Finished with premium Heritage Collection fabrics, vegan leather accents and thoughtful details throughout, the Mountain Buggy Terrain Travel System is made for families who love to explore without compromising on comfort, style or safety.

product_name: Mountain Buggy Duet TWIN Travel System - Caviar - Caviar
description: Designed for growing families from day one, the Mountain Buggy Duet Twin Travel System brings together the ultra-compact Duet V4 Pushchair with two Mountain Buggy Nest R129 i-Size Car Seats and two rotating ISOFIX bases. Whether you're welcoming twins or need a complete travel solution for two little ones, this bundle delivers outstanding safety, comfort and all-terrain performance from birth. Despite being a side-by-side pushchair, the Duet is no wider than many single buggies, making it remarkably easy to navigate through standard doorways, busy shops and everyday adventures. Air-filled tyres, rear-wheel suspension and three-mode front wheels provide exceptional handling across everything from city streets to countryside trails, while lie-flat sling seats, UPF50+ canopies and breathable fabrics ensure both babies travel in complete comfort. Each included Nest R129 i-Size Car Seat is suitable from 40-87cm (approximately birth to 20+ months) and pairs with its own 180° rotating ISOFIX base for effortless loading and secure installation. Lightweight yet packed with advanced safety features, the car seats offer extended rear-facing travel, intuitive visual installation indicators and one-hand release for smooth transitions from car to pushchair. Beautifully finished with premium Heritage Collection fabrics and vegan leather accents, the Mountain Buggy Duet Twin Travel System is built to adapt as your family grows, giving you confidence, flexibility and comfort wherever your adventures take you.

product_name: Charlie Crane KUMI Crib Fitted Sheet - Milk
description: The Charlie Crane KUMI Crib Fitted Sheet in Milk is designed to pop over your KUMI crib mattress (sold separately). This super-soft fitted sheet will keep your little one comfy whilst protecting the mattress.

product_name: Mushie Organic Muslin Swaddle - Dinosaurs
description: The Mushie Organic Muslin Swaddle in Dinosaurs is made from 100% organic cotton and pre-washed for softness against baby’s delicate skin. Perfect for swaddling, nursing and cuddling your baby, the super-soft muslin stays breathable while keeping baby warm and secure.

product_name: Bugaboo Organizer - Dusty Pink
description: The Bugaboo Organizer is perfect for parents who love to keep their essentials close at hand. Thoughtfully designed with plenty of handy pockets, it makes staying organised effortless. It’s super easy to attach and remove thanks to the sturdy Velcro tabs, so you can pop it on your pushchair in seconds. Not just a pushchair organiser, it also transforms into a stylish and compact tote bag - simply grab and go when you’re heading out without the pushchair. Elevated in Earth-inspired tones for effortless styling, the Bugaboo Organizer is designed to last and keep up with everyday adventures. Practical, versatile, and beautifully designed, it’s a must-have for parents on the move.

product_name: Avionaut Maxspace Smart Car Seat - Black
description: Meet the Avionaut MaxSpace Smart Car Seat - designed to support your growing little one through everyday journeys and family adventures. Suitable from 100–150cm (approximately 15–50kg), this forward-facing car seat offers a practical solution that grows alongside your child. With flexible installation options using either ISOFIX or your vehicle's seat belt, the MaxSpace Smart is designed to fit seamlessly into family life. Featuring a reclining function and meeting ECE R129 safety standards, it brings together everyday convenience and reassurance for every journey.

product_name: Britax Romer Seat Organiser - Black
description: The Britax Romer Seat Organiser in Black can easily be attached to your cars front seats. It not only protects the seat from dirty feet but also offers plenty of space for toys, drinks and snacks within your little one's reach. So you and your baby can enjoy a pleasant and stress-free journey.

product_name: Ergobaby Omni Classic Carrier - Cotton - Pure Black
description: A four-position, newborn-ready carrier designed for baby's first 48 months, with patented, industry-leading ergonomic support for everyday comfort and versatility.

product_name: Stokke® Sleepi™ Mini Fitted Sheet - Birch Beige
description: The Stokke Sleepi Mini Fitted Sheet in Birch Beige is a soft and breathable cotton sheet, gentle on delicate skin and offering ultimate comfort for peaceful nights. With elastic all the way around, it provides a secure, snug fit, ensuring a safe and restful sleep for your baby. Crafted with quality and safety in mind, the Stokke Sleepi Mini Fitted Sheet is Oeko-Tex® Standard 100, Class 1 approved, meaning it’s free from harmful substances and it's available in a range of playful colours, so you can find the perfect match for your nursery décor. For dreamy nights and cosy naps, this fitted sheet is the perfect finishing touch for your baby's Stokke® Sleepi™ Mini Bed.

product_name: Elodie Details Portable Changing Pad - Off Black
description: The Elodie Details Portable Changing Pad in Off Black is ideal to keep in your changing bag for on the go. Designed with removable and washable terrycloth as well as smart pockets for nappies, creams and baby wipes.

product_name: Flybaby Baby Carrier - Mokka
description: Designed to bring you and your baby closer, the Flybaby Baby Carrier blends thoughtful innovation with beautifully simple design. Crafted from an ultra-soft 3D-knit fabric, it offers a gentle, second-skin feel while evenly distributing weight to keep both you and your little one comfortable throughout the day. From those first newborn snuggles to busy days on the go, Flybaby adapts effortlessly as your baby grows. The breathable knit helps regulate temperature, while the ergonomic design supports your baby in the natural M-position for healthy development - certified by the International Hip Dysplasia Institute. Lightweight, compact and easy to use, it slips neatly into your bag and is always ready when you need it - whether you’re heading out for a stroll or simply enjoying a quiet moment together at home. Thoughtfully made using recycled materials and designed to last, it’s a carrier you’ll reach for every day. Loved by parents and recommended by midwives, Flybaby brings comfort, closeness and calm to your everyday routine.

product_name: Mama Shack Foldable Travel Changing Mat - Vintage Bear
description: Say hello to stress-free, on-the-go nappy changes with Mama Shack's Foldable Travel Mat. Lightweight, portable, and easy to fold with a secure popper fastening, this mat is a must-have for any busy parent. Perfect for covering public changing tables or for quick, convenient changes at the park, pool, or while on holiday. Compact and versatile, it fits perfectly inside changing bags and nappy caddies.

product_name: Baby Brezza Food Maker Deluxe - Black & White
description: Make healthy, homemade baby meals the easy way with the Baby Brezza One Step Food Maker Deluxe. Designed to simplify family life, this clever appliance steams and blends food automatically in one simple step. In as little as 10 minutes, you can create up to 820ml of nutritious, delicious baby food made from real, fresh ingredients. With three easy-to-use settings - Steam & Blend, Steam Only, or Blend Only - and an intuitive LCD control panel, it’s never been simpler to prepare smooth purées or textured meals for every stage of your baby’s weaning journey. It even comes with three reusable pouches and funnels to make, store, and serve food conveniently at home or on the go. Thoughtfully designed to save you time while helping you nourish your little one with wholesome, homemade meals, the Baby Brezza Food Maker Deluxe truly takes the fuss out of feeding.

product_name: Etta Loves XL Muslin 0-4m - Starfish
description: The Etta Loves Sensory XL Muslin 0-4m in Starfish print is perfect for cuddles, spillages, for using as a lightweight blanket, breastfeeding cover or to put over a playmat to encourage tummy time. You can even wind it up in a car window for shade and stimulation for calmer car journeys. Designed to the millimetre to support babies' cognitive and visual development between birth and around four months.

product_name: MORI Baby Mittens - Oatmeal Stripe

product_name: MORI Ribbed Front Opening Year Round Sleeping Bag 1.5 TOG - Mint - 0-6m
description: The MORI Ribbed Front Opening Year Round Sleeping Bag 1.5 TOG in Mint is is designed to keep little ones warm in the colder months. Crafted in our softest organic cotton bamboo fabric for a gentle touch on a little one's sensitive skin. The Sleeping Bag features a concealed zip-up front to make getting ready for bed simpler. Sizes 6-24m + 2-4y are adjustable to grow with your baby or toddler. This sleeping bag has been designed to be used instead of a blanket, as they can cause safety issues including waking up uncovered and increasing the risk of SIDS. Sleeping bags act as a wearable blanket, which can’t be kicked off, helping you as a parent to have peace of mind when putting your baby to sleep. We would recommend that you make sure your baby’s head cannot pass through the neck hole when fastened; if it can, the sleeping bag is too big.

product_name: Etta Loves XL Muslin - Sycamore
description: Designed to inspire little eyes and calm busy days, the Etta Loves XL Muslin in Sycamore is a versatile essential with a clever twist. The beautiful, nature-inspired print is carefully crafted to support your baby’s developing vision from around five months onwards, using the latest research into infant visual development. From cuddles and feeding to tummy time and car journeys, this generously sized muslin is there for every moment – soft, sustainable, and scientifically designed to bring a sense of calm and wonder. Made from 100% GOTS certified organic cotton, it’s gentle on delicate skin and kinder to the planet too.

product_name: Thule Urban Glide 3 Travel System - Mid Blue
description: Made for everyday adventures from those first newborn strolls onwards, the Thule Urban Glide 3 Travel System brings everything you need for comfortable, confident journeys together in one beautifully considered bundle. Choose from Black or Mid Blue and enjoy a complete setup that moves seamlessly from car to pushchair, city streets to country paths, and newborn days to toddler adventures. At the heart of the system is the Thule Urban Glide 3, a lightweight all-terrain stroller with large air-filled tyres, smooth manoeuvrability and a supportive, adjustable seat. For newborns, the Thule 3 Bassinet creates a cosy, ventilated lie-flat space with a UPF 50+ canopy, while the included raincover helps keep little ones protected when the weather turns. When it’s time to travel by car, the Thule Maple Infant Car Seat pairs with the Thule Alfi ISOFIX Base for a secure, streamlined setup. EasyDock technology makes attaching the car seat simple, while the 180° rotation on the Alfi base makes getting your little one in and out of the car easier. The included Urban Glide 3 Single Adapter lets you click the Maple onto the stroller frame for convenient transitions without disturbing a sleeping baby. Thoughtfully chosen to make family life a little easier, this complete travel system has comfort, practicality and adventure covered — with rain covers for both the stroller and bassinet included for all-weather outings.

product_name: BeSafe iZi Twist i-Size Car Seat - Fresh Black Cab
description: The BeSafe iZi Twist i-Size Car Seat in Fresh Black Cab is a rotation seat that has passed the world’s toughest crash test "the Plus Test". It also offers advanced levels of comfort and adjustability for your little one. The convenient side-to-side rotation allows you to easily take your child in and out of the seat by rotating it towards you. Fresh Black Cab is BeSafe's basic fabric. It's a woven fabric with a sturdy structure for easy maintenance, made from 100% recycled polyester.
